properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 13 at 4:58PM EDT until September 13 at 5:15PM EDT by NWS Cleveland OH
properties.description:
At 457 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Hubbard, or
near Sharon, moving east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Minor damage to vehicles is possible. Expect damage to
trees and power lines.

Locations impacted include...
Youngstown, Warren, Boardman, Niles, Campbell, Hubbard, Canfield,
Newton Falls, Lordstown, Vienna Center, Hilltop, Maplewood Park,
Austintown, Struthers, Girard, Vienna, McDonald, Poland, Craig Beach,
and Lowellville.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with this storm, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 13 at 1:24PM MST until September 13 at 4:30PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Yavapai County in west central Arizona...

* Until 430 PM MST.

* At 124 PM MST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area from Poland Junction to Mayer,
including the Big Bug Creek drainage. Between 0.75 and 1.75 inches
of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.25 to 0.75
inches are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing
or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
normally dry washes, urban areas, highways, streets and
underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Dewey-Humboldt, Mayer, Spring Valley, Cordes Lakes, Centennial
Park, Poland Junction and Cordes Junction.

This includes the following highways...
State Route 69 between mile markers 263 and 279. Interstate 17 near
mile marker 262.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Hackberry Creek, Big Bug Creek, Turkey Creek, Yarber Wash, Brushy
Wash, Mineral Creek, Agua Fria River, Antelope Creek, Badger Spring
Wash, Chaparral Gulch, Wolf Creek, Grapevine Creek and Cedar Creek.
properties.instruction:
Flooding of washes and creeks will occur, some dirt roads will become
muddy and impassable. Paved roads and underpasses could become
flooded as well.

Low water crossings will become dangerous in heavy rain. Do not
attempt to cross flooded roads. Find an alternate route.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 4:30 PM MST. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 4:30 PM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 13 at 3:46PM EDT until September 13 at 7:45PM EDT by NWS Buffalo NY
properties.description:
FFWBUF

The National Weather Service in Buffalo has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southern Niagara County in western New York...

* Until 745 PM EDT.

* At 346 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1.5 and 2 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 1.5 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Lockport, Pendleton, Sanborn, Rapids, Pendleton Center, Gasport and
Wolcottsville.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Keep children away from storm drains, culverts, creeks and streams.
Water levels can rise rapidly and sweep children away.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 13 at 3:43PM EDT until September 13 at 7:00PM EDT by NWS Upton NY
properties.description:
...Observed flooding changed to Minor severity and increased in
duration for the following rivers in New Jersey...

Saddle River near Lodi affecting Bergen County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring.

* WHERE...Saddle River near Lodi.

* WHEN...Until this evening.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 3:30 PM EDT Sunday the stage was 6.6 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 5.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 3:30 PM EDT Sunday was 6.8 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage this
evening and continue falling to 2.4 feet early Wednesday
afternoon.
- Flood stage is 5.5 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 6.6
feet on 06/19/1972.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this evening at 700 PM EDT.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 13 at 2:06PM MST until September 13 at 5:00PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Havasu Creek basin in...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...This includes the
Colorado River between river miles 156 and 158.

* Until 500 PM MST.

* At 206 PM MST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain over the Havasu Creek basin. Between 0.5 and 1 inch of
rain has fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.25 to 0.75 inches
are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Havasu Creek basin.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Havasu Creek basin.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Little Navajo Falls, Mooney Falls, Beaver Falls, Hualapai Hilltop,
Havasupai Reservation and Supai.

This includes the Colorado River between river miles 156 and 158.

This includes the following swimming holes...
All swimming holes on Havasu Creek near Supai.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Little Coyote Canyon, Sinyella Canyon, Heather Wash, Pasture Wash,
Colorado River, Black Tank Wash and Havasu Creek.
properties.instruction:
Campers and hikers should hustle to higher ground immediately! Stay
away from creeks and washes!

Foot bridges will be washed out in Supai Campground. Some campsites
will be flooded. Campers may be stranded in portions of the
campground.

properties.areaDesc: Currituck Sound; Coastal waters from NC VA border to Currituck Beach Light NC out 20 NM
properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued September 13 at 4:49PM EDT until September 13 at 6:15PM EDT by NWS Wakefield VA
properties.description:
SMWAKQ

The National Weather Service in Wakefield has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from NC VA border to Currituck Beach Light NC out 20
NM...
Currituck Sound...

* Until 615 PM EDT.

* At 449 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing
waterspouts was located near Knotts Island Bay, moving southeast at
10 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* The severe thunderstorm will be near...
Knotts Island Bay around 455 PM EDT.
Currituck Beach Light around 515 PM EDT.
Currituck Beach around 525 PM EDT.
Currituck Sound around 535 PM EDT.
properties.instruction: Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.
